action.name: Rootform
action.description: Analyze or compare evidence, evaluate selected Policies, and present Rootform reports in GitHub

version.description: Exact published version; omit to reuse a verified version in this job

github-token.description: GitHub token for release API requests and enabled PR comments

project.description: Project directory for raw evidence or Policy selection; defaults to workspace

offline.description: Prepare selected external content without network access

cache.description: Cache verified external sources selected by rootform.lock

input.description: Path to plan JSON, state JSON, Form or Comparison Form

plan-file.description: Matching saved plan for input; pairing must verify

before.description: Before plan JSON, state JSON or single-input Form

after.description: After plan JSON, state JSON or single-input Form

before-plan-file.description: Matching saved plan for before; pairing must verify

after-plan-file.description: Matching saved plan for after; pairing must verify

stage.description: Architecture stage: planned, refreshed or recorded

before-stage.description: Before stage: planned, refreshed or recorded

after-stage.description: After stage: planned, refreshed or recorded

side.description: Comparison sides: before, after or both; defaults to both

policy.description: Policy selectors, one per line, within selected Packs

policy-pack.description: Policy Pack source directories or compiled files, one per line

check.description: Check all project-selected Policies without explicit selectors or overlays

summary.description: Append CLI Markdown to GitHub Job Summary

upload-artifact.description: Upload Form and derived reports as one artifact; never raw inputs

artifact-name.description: Artifact name; defaults to a unique name per invocation, including matrix jobs

retention-days.description: Artifact retention: 1–90 days, capped by repository limit

comment.description: Update one same-repository PR comment; requires write permission and job serialization

form.description: Path to the supplied or generated Form

report.description: Path to the complete CLI Markdown report

html.description: Path to the self-contained HTML Explorer

exit-code.description: Rootform check exit code, exposed before the gate

artifact-id.description: Uploaded artifact ID for cross-job download
